summary: elaina-baileys aliases libsignal to third-party scope at mutable @latest tag
details: package.json declares the core runtime dependency `libsignal` as an npm alias to a third-party scoped package pinned to the mutable `latest` tag: "libsignal": "npm:@otaxayun/libsignal-node@latest". The upstream Baileys library uses the standard libsignal-node implementation; this fork redirects resolution to the `@otaxayun` scope with no version pin and no integrity hash. Every `npm install` of elaina-baileys resolves that alias and installs whatever bytes @otaxayun/libsignal-node currently publishes, running any lifecycle scripts shipped in that tarball on the installer's machine. Control of the delivered code sits entirely with whoever owns the @otaxayun scope and can be changed at any time without any update to elaina-baileys itself.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
